_comment: config.json for the build GitHub Pages serves at https://hx.foggyden.org/. The Pages workflow copies it over the default one in dist/; the repo's public/config.json stays generic.
_defaultServer: The page is on https, so this has to be wss://: a browser refuses a plain ws:// socket from a secure page.
title: Hotline
_allowCustomServer: true: this build is also a client for anybody's server, not only this one. hxd-ng answers the page's cross-origin fetches with CORS for exactly this.
